title: Tide Height vs Departure Delay
dataSources: Battery telemetry (`marine:battery`), AIS traffic (`marine:ais`), shore power (`marina:power`), tide forecasts (`tide:table`), export syncs (`marine:export`).
app: Boating and marine telemetry — Victron BMV battery exports, AIS transponder logs, shore-power meter readings, and NOAA tide tables — streamed to Splunk HEC via NMEA exports and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=tide:table harbor=* departure_delay_min=*
| stats avg(departure_delay_min) as avg_departure_delay_min, count as events by harbor
| sort - avg_departure_delay_min
description: Shows average departure delay minutes by harbor for tide-aware departures.
value: Average departure delay minutes by harbor helps compare tide-aware departures across the factors that matter most.
implementation: Capture `departure_delay_min` on `tide:table` events and normalize `harbor` so Splunk can summarize performance by harbor.
visualization: Bar chart of average departure delay minutes by harbor.
grandmaExplanation: It celebrates the average departure delay minutes for each harbor so you can see what works best for tide-aware departures.
